task.title: Creating an API key
task.shortdesc: Create a key to authenticate your API requests. Each key is limited to the scopes you choose.

step.cmd: Click Create key and give it a name that says where it's used, such as "Website listings".
Select only the scopes the integration needs.

strow.stentry: List and read animals, photos and statuses
Create intakes and update animal profiles
Read applications and adoptions (includes personal data)
Submit applications from your own forms

step.cmd: Click Create and copy the key.

stepresult.p: The full key is shown only once. If you lose it, delete the key and create a new one.

result.p: Send the key as a bearer token in the Authorization header of every request:
